extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: Based on both these, we think the overall full year growth will be between 22% to 23%.
items.why: FY26 AUM grew 22.5%, inside the 22 to 23% range given a quarter earlier.

items.quote: We foresee that the number next year as we enter could be anywhere between 165 to 175 basis points
items.actual: Re-set to 145 to 160 bps in April
items.actual_quote: So on an annual basis, 175 goes down to 145 to 160? Rajeev Jain: That's perfect.
items.why: Range lowered by about 20 bps one quarter later, partly from a change in how recoveries are presented. Compare like for like.

items.quote: We have to ensure that we grow nicely, which is where the 22% to 24% guidance has been given.
items.actual_quote: AUM, as you can see, grew by 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores
items.why: Running above the top of the range at the half-year mark.

items.quote: the credit cost guidance, Rajeev, you mentioned basically of 1.45% to 1.6%
items.actual: 1.56% in Q2 (1.32% before a ₹337 cr overlay)
items.actual_quote: loan loss to average AUF improved to 1.56% from 1.88% last year
items.why: Inside the range, but near the top once the macro overlay is counted.

items.quote: Return on equity came in at 20% in the current quarter, we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.
items.actual_quote: ROA for the quarter came in at 4.6% and ROE came in at 20.6%.

items.quote: And the guidance that we are giving for next year is 4.4% to 4.6%.
items.actual_quote: ROA for the quarter came in at 4.6%
items.why: At the top of the range.

items.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.
items.why: Due at the Q4 FY27 call.
